ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (35) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Воздержание» (vozderzhanie, 'abstinence, self-restraint') is rendered 'abstinence' throughout and «невоздержанность» (nevozderzhannost') 'intemperance'; the conqueror sayings keep their repeated «победить/победитель» (pobedit'/pobeditel', 'conquer/conqueror'). Attributions follow the print: «Блекки» (Blekki) is 'Blackie', not the website's expanded name, and «человеколюбие» (chelovekolyubie) is 'love of humanity'.
